privacy.intro: Your privacy is very important to us. This policy describes, transparently and in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13.709/2018), how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information on the Dualis app.
privacy.s1_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
privacy.s1_list:
• Registration data: name, email, date of birth, and password.
  • Profile information: photos, bio, church, interests, and gender.
  • Faith data: religious confession (Catholic, Evangelical, Orthodox, etc.), ministry, and denomination.
  • Location: city, state, country, and geographical coordinates (to show people nearby).
  • Biometric data: identity verification selfie (when requested by the user).
  • Technical data: device type, operating system, push notification token, and device language.
privacy.s1_footer: Some of this data is classified as sensitive personal data by the LGPD, as detailed in section 2.
privacy.s2_intro: Given the nature of the application — a dating service aimed at the Christian community — we process the following categories of sensitive personal data:
privacy.s2_list:
• ✝️ Religious belief: your confession of faith, denomination, church, and level of ministerial participation. This data is essential to connect you with people of compatible spiritual values.
  • 👤 Gender: information used exclusively to display compatible profiles according to your relationship preferences.
  • 📍 Geolocation: coordinates and city/state are used to show people near you.
  • 📸 Biometric data: the profile verification selfie is a biometric data processed solely to confirm that you match the profile photos.
privacy.s2_footer:
Legal basis: All of these sensitive data are processed with your explicit consent, pursuant to Art. 11, item I of the LGPD. By accepting the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy at the time of registration, you freely, informatively, and unequivocally consent to the processing of this data for the described purposes.

Strict purpose: This data is used exclusively to operate the compatibility and connection service between users, never being sold or shared with third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.
privacy.s3_intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
privacy.s3_list:
• Operate, maintain, and improve the service.
  • Connect you with other compatible users based on faith, location, age, and interests.
  • Send push and email notifications (matches, likes, messages, and service updates).
  • Verify profile identity (verification badge).
  • Ensure community security and prevent fraud.
  • Generate anonymous and aggregated statistics to improve the service.
  • Comply with legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.s4_intro: Dualis may send push notifications to your device, including alerts for:
privacy.s4_list:
• New matches (reciprocal connections).
  • Received likes ('hellos').
  • New messages in chat.
  • Important service updates.
privacy.s4_footer:
🔔 Activation: Push notifications are activated upon your authorization while using the app.

🔕 Deactivation: You can deactivate push notifications at any time directly in the app settings (tab 'Config' → 'Receive Push Notifications'), without needing to access the operating system settings. Deactivating notifications does not affect the operation of the service.
privacy.s5_intro: By creating your account on Dualis, you authorize the sending of service-related emails, including:
privacy.s5_list:
• Notifications of new matches and received likes.
  • Unread message alerts.
  • App news and updates.
  • Account security communications.
privacy.s5_footer:
📧 Cancellation: All promotional and notification emails contain an unsubscribe link in the footer. By clicking this link, you will stop receiving that type of communication by email. Essential account security emails (password reset, security alerts) will continue to be sent as necessary.

Legal basis: Sending service emails is based on the legitimate interest of the controller (Art. 7, IX of the LGPD) and on the execution of the contract (Art. 7, V), with the possibility of opting out at any time.
privacy.s6_intro: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data under any circumstances. We share information only:
privacy.s6_list:
• With essential infrastructure providers to operate the service (hosting, cloud storage, email service).
  • With advertising and analytics partners, to measure the effectiveness of our marketing campaigns and app install attribution. This sharing uses the device's advertising identifier (Advertising ID) and usage events (such as registration and subscription completion), and never includes your sensitive personal data (faith, precise location, or biometric data).
  • When required by law, court order, or determination of a competent authority.
  • To protect the rights, property, or safety of Dualis, its users, or the public.
privacy.s6_footer: All third-party providers are contractually obligated to protect your data and to use it only for the specified purposes.
privacy.s7_intro: We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal data, including:
privacy.s7_list:
• Data encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS).
  • Secure storage with access control.
  • Secure authentication (password hashing).
  • Continuous vulnerability monitoring.
privacy.s7_footer: However, no security system is 100% infallible. We recommend that you keep your password secure and do not share it with third parties.
privacy.s8_intro: In accordance with Art. 18 of the LGPD, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.s8_list:
• Confirmation of the existence of the processing of your data.
  • Access to the personal data we collect about you.
  • Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
  • Anonymization, blocking, or elimination of unnecessary or excessive data.
  • Data portability to another service provider.
  • Elimination of personal data processed with your consent.
  • Information about entities with which your data is shared.
  • Revocation of consent at any time.
privacy.s8_footer: You can exercise most of these rights directly in the app settings (edit profile, delete account). For other rights, please contact our DPO (section 12).
privacy.s9_intro: We offer a voluntary identity verification system via a gesture selfie. When requesting verification:
privacy.s9_list:
• You send us a selfie performing a specific gesture.
  • We compare the selfie with your profile photos.
  • If approved, your profile receives a verification badge (blue icon).
  • If you change your photos after verification, the badge is automatically removed.
privacy.s9_footer:
The verification selfie (biometric data) is processed upon your explicit consent, stored securely, and used exclusively for identity verification and fraud prevention purposes.

IMPORTANT: The verification badge only confirms that the person matches the profile photos. It DOES NOT guarantee the character, intentions, or background of the user.
privacy.s10_intro:
Dualis acts as an intermediary platform to facilitate connections between users. We do not conduct criminal background checks, financial status checks, marital status checks, or verify the truthfulness of all information provided by users.

⚠️ DUALIS IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR:
privacy.s10_list1:
• Acts, conduct, statements, or omissions of other users.
  • Frauds, scams, deceptions, or financial losses resulting from interactions with third parties.
  • Moral, material, or psychological damages resulting from meetings or conversations between users.
privacy.s10_list2:
• Personal documents (ID, passport, etc.).
  • Bank details (account number, branch, password).
  • PIX keys or transfer codes.
  • Money, gifts, or valuables under any circumstances.
  • Passwords, verification codes, or access to personal accounts.
privacy.s10_footer: If anyone asks for any of these items, report them immediately via the report button on the user's profile. Your security also depends on your caution. For more guidance, consult our Safety Tips.
privacy.s11_intro: Your personal data is kept as long as your account is active on Dualis.
privacy.s11_list:
• Account deletion: You can delete your account at any time in the app settings (Profile → Delete Account). Upon deleting your account, all your personal data, photos, matches, and conversations will be permanently removed.
  • Deletion timeframe: After the deletion request, your data will be eliminated from our systems within 30 days, except when retention is necessary to comply with legal or regulatory obligations.
  • Anonymized data: Aggregated and anonymized statistical data (which does not allow personal identification) may be retained for service improvement purposes.
privacy.s12_text:
To exercise your rights under the LGPD, revoke your consent, or clarify doubts regarding the processing of your personal data, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) via email: dualis.love.app@gmail.com.

Response time: We commit to responding to your requests within 15 business days, as required by law.

terms.s1_text: By downloading, installing or using the Dualis.love app ("Service"), you agree to comply with these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any of these terms, you should not use the app.
terms.s2_text: Dualis.love is a platform designed to promote friendships and serious relationships among members of the Christian community. All users are expected to maintain respectful conduct aligned with Christian values.
terms.s3_text: To use Dualis.love, you must be at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity. By creating an account, you declare and warrant that you meet these requirements.
terms.s4_li1: Use the service for illegal or unauthorized purposes.
terms.s4_li2: Post offensive, defamatory, obscene content or content that violates third-party rights.
terms.s4_li3: Harass, intimidate or stalk other users.
terms.s4_li4: Create fake profiles or impersonate another person.
terms.s5_text: Your privacy is important to us. Please refer to our Privacy Policy to understand how we collect and use your data. We recommend caution when sharing personal information with other users.
terms.s6_text: You can delete your account and all associated data directly through the app settings. If you no longer have access to the app, deletion can be requested remotely by sending an email to dualis.love.app@gmail.com with the subject "Account Deletion", using the same email address from the original registration. The request will be processed within 7 business days.
terms.s7_text: We reserve the right to modify or discontinue the service at any time, temporarily or permanently, with or without notice.
terms.s8_text: If you have questions about these terms, contact us through the app's official channels or via the Data Protection Officer (DPO), João Paulo do Couto, email: dualis.love.app@gmail.com.
